title: #124 Studying Abroad
prompt: It is often argued that studying overseas is overrated. There are many scholars who study locally. To what extent do you agree with this？

promptSegments.text: It is often argued that studying overseas is overrated.
There are many scholars who study locally.
To what extent do you agree with this？

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying in a foreign country gives students many chances to learn new things.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying in a foreign country gives students many chances to learn new things.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is that students meet many new people when they study far from home.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is that students meet many new people when they study far from home.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the cultural and academic benefits of studying abroad, showing that it expands a student's view of the world.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the cultural and academic benefits of studying abroad, showing that it expands a student's view of the world.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the social and personal benefits, arguing that studying abroad helps students build a diverse network of friends and improves communication skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the social and personal benefits, arguing that studying abroad helps students build a diverse network of friends and improves communication skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying abroad provides unique opportunities for personal growth and cultural understanding, making students more independent and adaptable.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying abroad provides unique opportunities for personal growth and cultural understanding, making students more independent and adaptable.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another benefit is the expansion of one's professional network through meeting people from diverse nations, which leads to global job opportunities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another benefit is the expansion of one's professional network through meeting people from diverse nations, which leads to global job opportunities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying abroad gives students a global perspective by exposing them to different ways of thinking and living, which broadens their understanding of human culture.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying abroad gives students a global perspective by exposing them to different ways of thinking and living, which broadens their understanding of human culture.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another major benefit is improving personal independence, as students must manage life in a new environment, making them more self-reliant and capable of solving problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another major benefit is improving personal independence, as students must manage life in a new environment, making them more self-reliant and capable of solving problems.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the claim that studying overseas is overrated by comparing local and international study experiences
keyArguments: Studying locally offers a familiar environment and cost-effectiveness, which can be advantageous for some students.
On the other hand, studying overseas provides a global perspective and cultural immersion, which can enhance academic and personal growth.
